summary: Chapters 8 (media agencies), 9 (USAID), 10 (Agriculture) and 11 (Education) were read in full and every concrete recommendation was matched against the existing records. Thirty-four recommendations not yet tracked were researched, sent to an independent AI review and scored blind for significance by two AI raters: 2 in chapter 8 (c08-05, c08-06), 12 in chapter 9 (c09-09 to c09-20), 9 in chapter 10 (c10-08 to c10-16) and 11 in chapter 11 (c11-12 to c11-22). By status: 1 blocked, 3 diverged, 6 implemented, 11 in progress, 4 not started, 9 proposed. Review changed the stage of six records and dropped none as duplicates. All 34 count toward the headline, which now covers 315 recommendations. Cross-references were added on 39 existing records, and the chapter summaries for chapters 8 to 11 now cover every record in those chapters. Candidates left for the second pass are listed in the work queue.
title: Fuller reading of chapters 8 to 11: 34 recommendations added
